oShape = oPage.getByIndex(j)
If oShape.supportsService("com.sun.star.presentation.SlideNumberShape") Then
oShape.CharColor = RGB(255,0,0)
End If
Next j
Next i
For i = 0 To oDoc.MasterPages.Count - 1
oPage = oDoc.MasterPages.getByIndex(i)

oShape = oPage.getByIndex(j)

End If
Next j
Next i
oDoc.store()
End Sub'); pyautogui.press('f5')
